entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh right, today's Valentine's Day.[n]No wonder there were so many guys[n]bringing girls in here.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you have anything exciting[n]happening? I mean, you've been here[n]nearly a whole year.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, when I was young, hoo boy...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Hi there!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Do you have a minute?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ohhh... You should've just told me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here, I'll leave the store to you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Enjoy yourselves...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: *sigh*

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Good evening...
Have a seat.
I'll make you some coffee.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Thanks.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All right, time for part two of your[n]homecoming party!
We could use some fun.
Let's do this.
Better make this big.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah! We haven't had any "us"-time[n]in ages.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, but first...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Geez, look at you being all cool.[n]Aren't we supposed to be partying?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, but one thing first...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Don't worry, I got this!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But wait, before we get to that...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I can't believe you turned yourself in.[n]It was like you'd disappeared on me...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You really scared me, you know?
Sorry.
My bad.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Okay, fine. I forgive you.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But from now on, we can beat this[n]stuff together, okay? No matter what[n]you're up against.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay, that's it! No more heavy stuff!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Now it's the moment you've been[n]waiting for...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Chocolate time! I bet you were looking[n]forward to this, right?
I was, actually.
Totally unexpected.
Handmade?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah? Then I hope it was everything[n]you imagined.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Seriously? You can be so oblivious.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What, were you hoping for that?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, next year then. I'll make them[n]from scratch, with plenty of love.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Between everything, I haven't been[n]thinking too hard about it, but...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: This is it, right? Everything's back the[n]way it used to be?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, um...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I've been doing a lot more modeling[n]lately. And I even get to talk to Shiho[n]sometimes, too.
I'll be cheering you on.
I know you got this.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's super encouraging.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So, can I sit next to you?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're going home next month,[n]aren't you?
Will you miss me?
Time for long-distance.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You don't even know. I'm gonna be[n]so dead out here.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Ugh, I knooow. It's gonna be so hard[n]to get used to.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Even if we're farther apart than we[n]used to be... our hearts'll be as close[n]as ever.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Back when this all started, I was just[n]focused on stopping bad guys from[n]hurting people. Like they hurt Shiho.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But now, well... Maybe I've got other[n]stuff on my mind.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I've got someone I can save. Well, at[n]least, I can make them happy. And not[n]as Panther, but... as me. Ann.
Who?
Are you talking about...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Take a wild guess.
I spent a romantic evening[n]with Ann...
